correctness.rationale: The closure trichotomy follows by distributing the residual multiset over remaining positions; with >=2 unfinished colors, no extra literal is forced. Minimal incompatible stems are same-position mismatches and m_a+1 over-quota literals; compatible minimal nonclosed stems saturate all other colors and leave omitted color a unused. Their proper subsets are closed, so every complete implicational basis needs a distinct antecedent for each; these implications are one-pass direct. Count is n*C(q,2)+sum C(n,m_a+1)+q*n!/prod(m_a!). Closed-set enumerator follows by deleting feasible but singly-unfinished partial words. Möbius inversion sum over subsets closing to T gives Boolean incomplete intervals, complete-word coefficient (-1)^r(1-s), top truncated multinomial. The independent closure enumeration checked all 512, 4096, 32768 literal subsets for m=(1,1,1),(2,1,1),(2,2,1) and 399 Möbius intervals in the first two cases. Universal proof is combinatorial, not extrapolated from these tests.

A simultaneous minimum Horn basis and explicit full Möbius function solve real structural/computational tasks for this natural family; neither follows mechanically from the generic existence of Duquenne–Guigues bases. Sharp basis size and all-interval inversion are useful exact invariants, not a manufactured tiny instance.
